empty.text: Press {key} to open an image, or drag one here.
empty.none: This folder has no image NeuralView can open. Press {key} to open another one.
notice.heic.text: NeuralView draws images with the Chromium engine, which cannot decode the HEIC/HEIF format. Export the picture as JPG or PNG from your phone or the Photos app and open it again. The information panel (I) still shows the file's details.
notice.broken.text: "{name}" could not be decoded: the file is damaged or only partly downloaded, or its content does not match its extension.
rot.jpeg: JPEG: the pixels stay as they are; only the EXIF orientation is updated (lossless).
rot.png: PNG: the image is rotated and written again without loss; extra text information in the file is not kept.
rot.webp: WebP: the image is rotated and encoded again at the highest quality.
rot.bmp: BMP: the image is rotated and written again.
hud.wrapped-first: ↺ Back to the start of the folder
hud.wrapped-last: ↻ On to the end of the folder
info.head: INFO
gps.warn.text: This image carries the coordinates of the place where it was taken. Worth knowing before you share it.
info.name: Name
info.no-exif: This file has no EXIF information.
toast.not-image: This file is not an image NeuralView opens: {name}
toast.no-rotation: There is no rotation to save.
toast.rotate-unsupported: A rotation cannot be saved in {format} format; the image only turns on screen.
toast.rotate-unsupported.any: A rotation cannot be saved in this format; the image only turns on screen.
toast.no-image: There is no image to copy.
toast.path-copied: File path copied to the clipboard.
toast.trashed: "{name}" was moved to the Recycle Bin.
toast.shown-in-explorer: NeuralNav is not installed; the file is shown in File Explorer.
toast.slideshow-needs-two: A slideshow needs at least two images in the folder.
dlg.delete.hint: You can restore it from the Recycle Bin.
dlg.rename.label: New name
dlg.rename.not-image: The new extension is not an image extension; the file will drop out of NeuralView's list.
about.text: The image viewer of the Neo-Istanbul network: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, SVG and AVIF.
about.hint: Version 1.1 · Your images open only on this computer; NeuralView sends nothing anywhere.

keys.copy-image: Copy the image to the clipboard
err.no-shell: This works only in the desktop app.
err.encode: The image could not be written as {format}.
err.access: No permission to access this location.
err.busy: The file is being used by another program.
err.exists: A file with this name already exists.
err.no-space: There is no space left on the disk.
err.copy-image: The image could not be copied to the clipboard.
err.name-chars: A name cannot contain these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

err.rotate-format: A rotation cannot be saved in this format.
